config.metric: fixed identity ULS on survey-weighted ordinal moments

criteria.dominance_family: Bonferroni within each fixed score, checked separately for raw and model covariance
criteria.correlation_family: Bonferroni all pairs of the complete candidate model, before score outcomes

limits: fixed original item set and oriented category coding; no outcome-based item drops or residual repairs
normal/delta inference conditional on the chosen model, fixed coding and weights
